name: Long March 6A
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: The 59th launch of the year for China's CASC, 629th all time. Their year has run at a launch every six days. No Long March 6A has failed in 28 flights.
slot_b_text: Astronauts on the International Space Station witness 16 sunrises and sunsets every single day.
